text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh... I'm so boooored!
I'm so bored I feel like I could flyyyy...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: All right, in that case, why not just take to the skies, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hup!
Now that that's settled, time to get ready right away!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Umm, I'm the power source so that's covered,
all we need left are wings, snacks, and—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, that's right...
Today is a training day...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever!
Not in the mood today, so Turbo's gonna slack off!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Gold Ship ended up prioritizing
aiming for the sky over training...
